name: ServiceNow ITSM
description: Incidents and Service Catalog requests in ServiceNow: raise an incident without duplicates (lookup reconciliation on correlation_id), wait for the outcome through a signed business-rule webhook with a polling safety net, check fulfilment, add work notes and attach generated documents.
